options.description: Priced from Neon's Launch plan: CU-hours, storage and public transfer; see x_price_sources. Tiers are priced running all month (730 h); scale to zero costs less. 1 CU = 4 GB RAM per Neon's plans page; 1 vCPU per CU is the skeleton's assumption. Features are the skeleton's and were not checked against Neon's extension list.

Priced from Supabase's dedicated compute sizes (Large to 8XL), its disk price and its Pro egress price; see x_price_sources. The Pro plan's monthly base fee is not included. Features are the skeleton's and were not checked against Supabase's extension list.

Priced from Neon's Scale plan: CU-hours, storage and public transfer; see x_price_sources. Tiers are priced running all month (730 h); scale to zero costs less. 1 CU = 4 GB RAM per Neon's plans page; 1 vCPU per CU is the skeleton's assumption. Features are the skeleton's and were not checked against Neon's extension list.
Priced from the AWS Price List for API requests after the first million; the free tier and delivery attempts to HTTP/SQS are not modelled.
Priced from the AWS Price List for image storage in eu-west-1; the estate does not report repository sizes, so ECR components stay unpriced.
Priced from the AWS Price List per GB ingested (tier 1, batch); the estate does not report Firehose volume, so Firehose components stay unpriced.
